resolutions.researcher_notes: CONTRADICTS THE SHEET. Every independent source found for this segment (FERC's own docket record, S&P Global Market Intelligence, and Kinder Morgan's own Q3 2020 earnings release) identifies the owner/applicant as Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America, LLC (NGPL) — majority-owned by Kinder Morgan (with Kinetik Holdings as JV partner) — not Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company (Transco), the Williams subsidiary recorded as Owner1=100%. No document, in an extensive search (FERC docket CP18-487 filings, two Federal Register notices, S&P Global, Kinder Morgan investor materials, Williams investor materials, NaturalGasIntel (paywalled, unusable)), connects Transco/Williams to this specific 'Sabine Pass Compression Project' segment. Notably, url_verifier.py --name 'Transcontinental Gas Pipeline' fails on the FERC EA (the primary source document for this row's Construction/Length/Location/Operator/Pressure/Proposal columns) precisely because the name never appears in it — itself corroborating evidence of the misattribution, not just a verifier quirk. Also notable: GEM's own gem.wiki page for this segment lists Operator='Natural Gas Pipeline Co' while listing Owner='Transco' — an internal inconsistency on GEM's own wiki page that appears to be the root of the sheet's Owner error (GEM's wiki Operator field is correct; the Owner field was apparently populated from the wrong company). Leaving this UNRESOLVED rather than proposing NGPL as a replacement value: correcting the Owner1 field itself is outside this unit's scope (sourcing the value on the sheet), and no source supports 'Transco' as owner to cite. Recommend the sheet's Owner1/Operator be reconciled to Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America, LLC (Kinder Morgan) for this specific segment.
